orgBilling.title: Billing
orgBilling.subtitle: What this organization's plan grants, what it has spent, and when the allowance comes back.

grace.title: A payment for this organization failed
grace.description: Everything keeps working until {date}. Update the payment method before then and nothing changes. After that date AI generations, new enrollments and new public course links stop, while learners already enrolled keep their courses.

lapsed.title: This organization's subscription has lapsed
lapsed.description: AI generations, new enrollments and new public course links have stopped. Nothing has been deleted: learners keep their courses, their progress and their certificates, and everything resumes the moment payment is restored.

warning.title: Your AI generations are running low
warning.description: {remaining} generations are left, top-ups included, less than a fifth of the {allowance} your plan grants each month. There's still room, but it's worth deciding on an upgrade or a top-up now, rather than once your authors are already stopped.

critical.title: You're almost out of AI generations
critical.description: {remaining} generations are left, top-ups included, against the {allowance} your plan grants each month. When they run out, chats, image generation and source indexing stop for everyone until the allowance resets.

usage.title: AI generations this period
usage.description: What this period holds (your plan's monthly allowance plus any top-up packs) and how much of it is gone.
usage.topupLegendSpent: Top-up packs: {remaining} left, {used} spent this period · never expire
usage.noReset: A one-time grant that does not reset.

breakdown.title: Where they went
breakdown.description: Every generation charged this billing period, by the person who ran it and by what it did. Refunded generations are not counted.
breakdown.empty: Nothing has been generated this period yet.
breakdown.topupNote: {topup} of these were paid for with top-up credits rather than the monthly allowance.

seats.title: Learner seats
seats.description: Distinct people enrolled in at least one course. Authors and admins who are not enrolled cost nothing.
seats.none: This plan includes no learner seats, so nobody can be enrolled yet.
seats.prorationNote: Added seats work immediately and renew with the plan. You will see what the rest of this period costs before anything is charged.
seats.unavailableNote: This plan does not sell additional seats. Choose a plan that does to enroll more learners.
seats.purchaseFailed: The seats could not be added. Please try again.
seats.confirmFailed: We could not work out the price just now. Please try again in a moment.
seats.confirmChargeNow: €{amount} plus VAT is charged to your card now, covering {quantity} seats for the rest of the current period.
seats.confirmRenewal: From {date} your plan carries {seats} extra seats at €{recurring} per month.
seats.confirmRenewalNoDate: From the next renewal your plan carries {seats} extra seats at €{recurring} per month.

topup.title: Top up generations
topup.description: Buy generations as a one-off. They never expire, and your monthly allowance is always spent first.
topup.unavailableDescription: Top-up packs are sold to organizations on a paid plan. Choose a plan below to unlock them.
topup.upgradeNote: Running out every month? A larger plan gives you more generations for less. See the plans below.
topup.checkoutFailed: Could not start checkout. Please try again.
topup.purchaseConfirmed: Top-up added. Your balance has been updated.
topup.purchasePending: Your payment is being confirmed. The generations will appear here shortly.

plan.title: Billing
plan.description: Subscribe to a plan to unlock generation credits and paid features. Managed entirely by Stripe.
plan.internalDescription: Your organization has complimentary access. Billing does not apply.
plan.activeDescription: Manage your subscription, payment methods, and invoices in the Stripe customer portal.
plan.checkoutFailed: Could not start checkout. Please try again.
plan.portalFailed: Could not open the billing portal. Please try again.
